subject: Send information through custom proxy server to shiny session

messages.author: 3e803ddda354f082
messages.subject: Send information through custom proxy server to shiny session
parts: I'm planning on using my own authentication system with my own database.  In order to do that the plan I'm thinking of doing is having a user hit the node.js application which will authenticate the user and store a session. Then it will forward the request that is only accessible from the first server.  The only problem I can see from this method is in shiny getting the username from session$user like it currently does.  Is there any way to send stuff to the shiny server from a proxy in front?
